controls.description: Access for terminated personnel is removed within one business day of termination.

tests.procedure: For a sample of twenty-five terminated users, inspected access removal records to determine that access was removed within one business day.
tests.result_text: Exception noted. For one (1) of twenty-five (25) sampled terminated users, access was removed nine business days after termination. Management's response: the account was disabled when the exception was identified, and no activity occurred after the termination date. An automated deprovisioning check was added in May.

evidence.quote: Access for terminated personnel is removed within one business day of termination.
